text: U.S. private employment rises by 90,000 in September. Service providers add 59,000 jobs and goods producers add 31,000, while financial and professional services contract. Firms with 50-499 workers account for 54,000 additions.

meta.note: ADP measures private payrolls and is distinct from the forthcoming BLS employment report.

text: August PCE inflation stands at 3.4% YoY and 0.3% MoM, while core PCE stands at 3.0% YoY and 0.2% MoM. Both annual readings are below consensus estimates but remain above the Fed's 2% target. Revised BEA methodology lowers July core PCE by 0.36 percentage point.

meta.note: Methodological revisions alter prior core readings, limiting direct comparison with earlier releases.

text: Eli Lilly's Phase 2 regimen combines eloralintide with tirzepatide, spanning amylin, GLP-1 and GIP pathways. The highest-dose combination records 23.3% average weight loss versus 14.8% for tirzepatide alone, alongside higher treatment discontinuation rates.

meta.note: Efficacy and discontinuation measures coexist within the same mid-stage trial configuration.
